script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Transiting Mars in Leo is forming a square to your natal Venus in Taurus, impacting your 1st House of identity. This aspect brings friction between your desire for stability and the demands in your home life, with the Moon in Virgo adding pressure to your 2nd House of finances. This cosmic clash demands you balance your Earth sign resilience with the initiative Mars is pushing upon you. In love, Venus's connection to Mars means passion is high, but so are arguments; singles should channel this energy into confident advances, while couples must avoid letting home disputes spill into relationships. With Jupiter trining your 10th House of career, financial opportunities are knocking, but the Mars square warns against impulsive investments. Beware the tendency to overcommit in your 7th House of partnerships today. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate this cosmic storm.
